children: According to ChainCatcher citing ZeroHedge and The Wall Street Journal, ZeroHedge suggested that Tesla CEO Elon Musk hire Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, and Musk replied, “That would be an honor.” The Wall Street Journal previously reported that Nvidia’s board was considering removing Huang, drawing market attention to his future.

title: Elon Musk Says Hiring Jensen Huang Would Be an Honor
